name: FallCon
blurb: An annual three-day board game and miniatures convention in Calgary, running since 1987, with hosted play, exhibitors, an auction and the Canadian Game Design Awards.
notes: Re-checked fallcon.com fresh (--fresh) and a web search (FallCon 40 2027 Calgary dates): the homepage still says outright 'Thank you for an amazing FallCon 39. Stay tuned for FallCon 40 dates', i.e. the organizers have not announced the next edition yet; no third-party source has a FallCon 40 date either. The only dated JSON-LD on the page is still a separate, smaller 'FallCon FleaMarket' sub-event (2026-04-25, Sunalta Community Hall), not the three-day convention itself, so it is not used as the edition; editions stays empty. Added 'last': FallCon 39 ran Aug 21-23, 2026 at Telus Convention Centre, Calgary, AB (also confirmed via visitcalgary.com) - already finished before this window starts (2026-10-05).
